comment: SPEC.md 1.1. A parser of `kind` returns `key` (hex) or fails with a message that is exactly `cipherlog key: ` + `error`. No error may contain a private key or any part of it. Hand-written cases.

cases.name: empty
cases.error: the key string is empty

cases.name: only whitespace
cases.error: the key string is empty

cases.name: private key given to the public parser
cases.error: this is a PRIVATE key (cipherlog-priv-v1:…); an app ships only the public key (cipherlog-pub-v1:…)

cases.name: public key given to the private parser
cases.error: this is a public key (cipherlog-pub-v1:…); opening logs needs the private key (cipherlog-priv-v1:…)

cases.name: prefix in uppercase
cases.error: the key string must start with cipherlog-pub-v1:

cases.name: quoted
cases.error: the key string must start with cipherlog-pub-v1:

cases.name: assignment around
cases.error: the key string must start with cipherlog-pub-v1:

cases.name: bare hex
cases.error: the key string must start with cipherlog-pub-v1:

cases.name: no-break space before
cases.error: the key string must start with cipherlog-pub-v1:

cases.name: byte order mark before
cases.error: the key string must start with cipherlog-pub-v1:

cases.name: private: wrong prefix
cases.error: the key string must start with cipherlog-priv-v1:

cases.name: prefix only
cases.error: expected 64 hex characters after the prefix, got 0

cases.name: 63 characters
cases.error: expected 64 hex characters after the prefix, got 63

cases.name: 65 characters
cases.error: expected 64 hex characters after the prefix, got 65

cases.name: a letter that is not hex
cases.error: character 10 after the prefix is not a hex digit ("g")

cases.name: text after the key
cases.error: character 65 after the prefix is not a hex digit (U+0020)

cases.name: characters are checked before the length
cases.error: character 21 after the prefix is not a hex digit ("z")

cases.name: no-break space after
cases.error: character 65 after the prefix is not a hex digit (U+00A0)

cases.name: fullwidth digit
cases.error: character 1 after the prefix is not a hex digit (U+FF10)

cases.name: emoji counts as one character
cases.error: character 6 after the prefix is not a hex digit (U+1F600)

cases.name: tab inside
cases.error: character 33 after the prefix is not a hex digit (U+0009)

cases.name: private: a character that is not hex is not shown
cases.error: character 3 after the prefix is not a hex digit

cases.name: private: text after the key is not shown
cases.error: character 65 after the prefix is not a hex digit

cases.name: private: wrong length
cases.error: expected 64 hex characters after the prefix, got 40
